response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS size FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(size) AS avg_size FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(g.size) AS combined_size, AVG(g.size - a.avg_size) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.size > a.avg_size
